# 📦 Dependency Update Review

## Package
Name, current version, target version and direct/transitive status.

## Reason
Security advisory, bug fix, compatibility, maintenance or feature requirement.

## Risk review
Breaking changes, peer dependencies, license, release notes, transitive changes and bundle impact.

## Verification
- [ ] Lockfile updated with npm.
- [ ] Clean npm ci succeeds.
- [ ] Jest tests pass.
- [ ] Production build passes.
- [ ] Manual smoke test completed where needed.

## Decision
Merge, defer or reject. Record owner and follow-up date.
